_meta.purpose: Master exercise library for LIFT. Feeds (1) Add-Exercise-on-the-Fly picker and (2) machine-aware logging. Grouped by muscle in Travis's priority order. Each exercise carries how it should be logged so the app handles the convention automatically.
_meta.owner: coaching chat (this file). Claude Code consumes it; does not edit the catalog.

convention_legend.per_side: Plate-loaded (machines + barbells/EZ bars). Log ONE SIDE's plate weight, exclude the bar.
convention_legend.as_marked: Selectorized stacks, dumbbells, fixed/pre-weighted bars. Log the marked/total number.

_meta.implement_legend: db | barbell | ez_bar | fixed_bar | machine_plate | machine_stack | cable | kb | bodyweight
_meta.scale_tag_note: For cable/functional work where the gym has multiple scales, the app stores a scale tag (e.g. hoist_cmj, versa, matrix_g3ms53) on its OWN track and never bridges/converts across tags. Tag & store, no auto-convert.
